## How it was verified
- [ ] `ctest` passes locally (OS: )
- [ ] Exercised by hand in the app (or: headless only, because …)

## Checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Core change has a headless test
- [ ] Every document change goes through a transaction
- [ ] New geometry names all its faces; naming regression test added if relevant
- [ ] User-facing errors are plain sentences with suggestions
- [ ] Unfinished UI stays disabled with a "coming in" note
- [ ] New dependencies added to `tools/dependencies.json` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`
- [ ] Decision recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md` if significant
